Door Hangers questions.

Quick answers before you upload artwork or request pricing.

Are door hangers good for local service businesses?

Yes. They work especially well for neighborhood routes and door-to-door visibility.

Can door hangers include coupons?

Yes. Coupons, QR codes, menus, and limited-time offers are common.

Can I print both sides?

Yes. Double-sided printing gives room for an offer on one side and details on the other.

What should a door hanger say?

Lead with a simple benefit or offer, then make the contact path obvious.
